title: Reintentar el combate desde la pausa
description: In a fight that can be fought again (everywhere but chapter 2's castle), the pause menu offers «Reintentar el combate»: the fight opens again from the start and the one left reaches nothing. Outside a fight the option is not there. Run it with --gpu: without it the scene's dissolve between fights is too slow for the headless browser.

steps.caption: Walking the street: the pause menu has no retry

steps.eval: window.gerard.battleUI.tweak(s => { s.foes[0].hp = 0; s.foes[1].hp = Math.ceil(s.foes[1].maxHp / 3); s.allies[0].hp = Math.ceil(s.allies[0].maxHp / 4); })

steps.caption: A fight going badly: one foe down, Gerard low
Paused in the fight: «Reintentar el combate» between Configuración and Salir del juego

steps.until: document.querySelector('#battle .turn-meta')?.textContent === 'TU TURNO' && window.gerard.battleUI.live?.foes.every(f => f.hp === f.maxHp) && window.gerard.battleUI.live?.allies.every(a => a.hp === a.maxHp)

steps.caption: The same fight from the start: every foe up and the party whole
